# Keep the code clean

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-blocks.mjs from scripts/blocks-meta.json. Edit that file, not this one. -->

### Modularity
- What: Split the code into small parts that each do one job.
- Applies when: every app.
- Stage: day-one
- Kind: checkable
- Scope: cross-cutting
- Proof: review
- Done when: Each file has one job that can be said in one line, and no file has become a catch-all.

### Separation
- What: Separation of concerns: keep the screens, the business rules and the data access in separate places.
- Applies when: every app.
- Stage: day-one
- Kind: checkable
- Scope: cross-cutting
- Proof: review
- Done when: Screen code, business rules and data access live in separate places, and the rules can be tested without the screen.
